influenceChannels: 4 uint8 palette indices (36=connective), then 4 uint8 weights per vertex
modifications: Existing 36-group parent registration constrained projection of 56 individual Z-Anatomy muscle meshes, with categorical smoothing and normalized weights. Source-derived head borders replace angle-based guesses. Not validated anatomy or non-rigid ICP.

headGroups.name: Deltoid · anterior
headGroups.flow: Clavicle to the front of the upper arm.

headGroups.name: Deltoid · lateral
headGroups.flow: Acromion to the outer upper arm.

headGroups.name: Deltoid · posterior
headGroups.flow: Scapular spine toward the back of the upper arm.

headGroups.name: Biceps · long head
headGroups.flow: Outer anterior upper arm; shortens as the elbow bends.

headGroups.name: Biceps · short head
headGroups.flow: Inner anterior upper arm toward the elbow.

headGroups.name: Triceps · long head
headGroups.flow: Scapula down the inner back of the upper arm.

headGroups.name: Triceps · lateral head
headGroups.flow: Outer posterior upper arm toward the elbow tendon.

headGroups.name: Triceps · medial head
headGroups.flow: Deep head visible near the inner elbow.

headGroups.name: Trapezius · upper
headGroups.flow: Neck toward the clavicle and acromion.

headGroups.name: Trapezius · middle
headGroups.flow: Upper spine horizontally toward the scapula.

headGroups.name: Trapezius · lower
headGroups.flow: Mid spine diagonally upward toward the scapula.

headGroups.name: Hamstrings · biceps long head
headGroups.flow: Outer posterior thigh toward the fibular head.

headGroups.name: Hamstrings · biceps short head
headGroups.flow: Distal outer thigh; lies beneath the long head.

headGroups.name: Hamstrings · semitendinosus
headGroups.flow: Long medial posterior thigh toward the inner knee.

headGroups.name: Hamstrings · semimembranosus
headGroups.flow: Broad medial posterior thigh.

headGroups.name: Calf · medial head
headGroups.flow: Inner calf belly converging toward the Achilles.

headGroups.name: Calf · lateral head
headGroups.flow: Outer calf belly converging toward the Achilles.

headGroups.name: Adductor longus
headGroups.flow: Superficial inner thigh from pubis toward femur.

headGroups.name: Adductor magnus
headGroups.flow: Broad inner and posterior thigh.

headGroups.name: Gracilis
headGroups.flow: Narrow strap along the inner thigh to the knee.

headGroups.name: Fibularis longus
headGroups.flow: Outer lower leg, continuing behind the lateral ankle.

headGroups.name: Fibularis brevis
headGroups.flow: Lower outer leg toward the base of the fifth metatarsal.

headGroups.name: Gluteus maximus
headGroups.flow: Broad diagonal fan across the buttock.

headGroups.name: Gluteus medius
headGroups.flow: Lateral hip fan toward the greater trochanter.

headGroups.name: Longissimus thoracis
headGroups.flow: Long column beside the thoracic and lumbar spine.

headGroups.name: Iliocostalis lumborum
headGroups.flow: Lateral lumbar column toward the lower ribs.

headGroups.name: Wrist extensor · longus
headGroups.flow: Radial forearm toward the back of the wrist.

headGroups.name: Wrist extensor · brevis
headGroups.flow: Shorter radial extensor beside the longus.
